name: PDF Smart Viewer for Elementor
author: DeKnows

sections.description:
PDF Smart Viewer for Elementor is a feature-rich WordPress plugin that adds a sophisticated PDF viewer widget to Elementor page builder. It provides users with an enhanced PDF viewing experience directly within their WordPress websites, complete with advanced navigation controls, zoom functionality, and modern UI design.

Features

  • Advanced PDF Rendering: Powered by PDF.js for fast and reliable PDF display
  • Smart Zoom Controls: Zoom in/out with smooth scaling (25% to 300%)
  • Fullscreen Mode: Immersive viewing experience with fullscreen support
  • Download Functionality: One-click PDF download for users
  • Print Support: Direct printing capability from the viewer
  • Page Navigation: Intuitive previous/next page controls
  • Page Information: Real-time page counter display
  • Responsive Design: Perfect display on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
  • Modern UI: Clean, professional interface with smooth animations
  • Dark Mode Support: Automatic dark mode detection and styling
  • Accessibility Features: Keyboard navigation and screen reader support
  • High Contrast Mode: Enhanced visibility for accessibility
  • Reduced Motion Support: Respects user motion preferences

Key Benefits

  • Easy Integration: Simple drag-and-drop widget for Elementor
  • Customizable Controls: Show/hide individual control elements
  • Flexible Styling: Extensive Elementor styling options
  • Performance Optimized: Efficient rendering with debounced resize handling
  • Cross-browser Compatible: Works across all modern browsers
  • SEO Friendly: Proper semantic HTML structure
  • Security: WordPress security best practices implementation

Perfect For

  • Business websites displaying PDF documents
  • Educational institutions sharing course materials
  • Legal firms presenting contracts and documents
  • Real estate agencies showing property brochures
  • Any website needing professional PDF viewing capabilities

Credits

  • Development: Mr. Hamad Khan – Founding Partner – Lead Development and Operations @Deknows Inc
  • Development: Mr. Amanat Ali – WordPress Site Builder @Deknows Inc
  • PDF.js: Mozilla Foundation (https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/)
  • Elementor: Elementor Ltd (https://elementor.com/)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pdf-smart-viewer-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress admin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Elementor page builder to add the “PDF Smart Viewer” widget to your pages
  4. Configure the widget settings to display your PDF files
sections.faq:
What are the system requirements?

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Elementor 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Modern browser with JavaScript enabled

Can I use PDFs from external URLs?

Yes, you can use PDFs from any publicly accessible URL. Just paste the URL in the widget settings.

Does it support password-protected PDFs?

Currently, the plugin supports publicly accessible PDFs. Password-protected PDFs are not supported.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes! The widget includes extensive styling options in Elementor for complete customization.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The viewer is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices.

Can I disable certain controls?

Yes, you can show/hide individual controls like zoom, fullscreen, download, and print buttons.

Does it support keyboard navigation?

Yes, the plugin includes full keyboard navigation support for accessibility.
